privacy.title: Before you start
privacy.subtitle: Privacy notice · Law 18-07
privacy.heading: What Minhajna keeps, and where
privacy.intro: A short notice before first use, always available in Help.
privacy.phoneText: Lists, roll calls, marks and record books are stored encrypted on the device. No account or internet is needed.
privacy.leaveText: This version does not connect to the internet, and does not ask for permission to. Pupils’ data never goes into the phone’s cloud backups.
privacy.neverText: No health, disability, religion or photos of pupils, no information about parents, and no addresses. An absence is excused or not, with no reason given.
privacy.trackingText: No ads, no analytics, no record of hours or location, and no crash reports.
privacy.publisherText: The open-source Minhajna project. This version connects to none of its servers.
privacy.rightsText: To see what the project holds about you, and to have it corrected and deleted within 10 days.

connections.title: What the app connects to, and why
connections.none: This version does not connect to the internet: it asks for no permission to, and sends and receives nothing.
connections.source: The source code link in Licences opens only after you confirm. Your browser opens it outside the app, with no record or identifier.
connections.register: Any connection the project adds is listed in the NETWORK.md file of the source code, with what is sent and why, before it reaches the app.

setup.title: Setup
setup.teachingIntro: Plans and documents are suggested from this choice.
setup.schoolsIntro: Each school has its own levels and subjects, and plans and documents are suggested from them.
setup.levelHint: You can choose more than one level.
setup.subject: Subject
setup.subjectHint: You can choose two subjects, such as Arabic with Islamic education.
setup.twoSubjects: Two subjects at this school, each with its own plan and book.
setup.severalSubjects: Each subject at this school has its own plan and book.
setup.nothingChosen: No level or subject chosen yet
setup.merged: Each school sends its timetable; they are merged into one week, with a warning at every clash. Each school keeps its own classes and books.
setup.nextHint: Write each school’s name and choose its level and subject.
setup.notSaved: The last change could not be saved on this phone.
setup.zoneHint: It picks your wilaya’s dates in the calendar, and is never sent to any server.
setup.zoneNone: No wilaya has this name or number.
setup.cardIntro: What the documents print at the top. Personal fields are optional and never leave this phone.
setup.name: Name
setup.fromStepOne: The subject and the school are changed in step 1.
setup.classesIntro: Type each class’s list by hand, or leave it for later.
setup.demoNote: {{pupils}} with made-up names, for trying the app, taking screenshots or reporting a problem without real pupils’ names.
setup.columnsNote: Only the needed columns are kept: registration number, name, sex. There is no limit to a class’s size.
setup.typeIntro: Name and sex. The registration number is optional for now; the official file fills it in later, so the pupil can be recognised.
setup.registrationTaken: Another pupil in the class already has this number.
setup.madeUpOnly: Type made-up names only, never your real pupils’ names.

week.title: Draw the week
week.heading: The week
week.intro: The timetable comes from the school, or is drawn by hand.
week.packageLater: Receiving the timetable from the school by code or file comes in a later version. Until then, the week is drawn by hand.
week.noWeek: The week is not drawn yet. You can draw it now or later.
week.brushHint: Choose the class, then tap the slots. A second tap with the same pen clears the slot.
week.optionLocked: Clear its slots first to remove it.
week.cellHint: Puts the chosen pen in the slot, or clears it
week.saveNote: In force from {{date}}, without changing any recorded session.
week.detailsHint: Opens the slot details: group, weeks, subject, room
week.subject: Subject
week.bivalentNote: If both subjects are taught to the same class, each has its own plan and book.
week.resolve: Open the slot to settle the clash
week.doubleShift: Double shift: mornings one week, afternoons the next
week.shiftA: In A weeks, classes are taught in the
week.shiftNote: A class drawn in one half-day is placed in the other for the other week.

times.title: Bell times
times.subtitle: Timetable
times.ramadanExpected: Ramadan times are expected from about {{date}}, and arrive with the calendar update once announced.
times.intro: Each session is its slot in the timetable, and its time comes from these bell times. If the bell times change, the timetable stays as it is.
times.double: Double shift: mornings one week, afternoons the next
times.rowHint: Opens the slot's time to change it
times.template: Source: the {{level}} template. To match the school's bell, tap a slot and change its time.
times.noTemplate: No template for this level yet. Tap a slot and enter its time from the school's bell.
times.ramadanRule: In Ramadan, each session keeps its slot and start time, lasts {{minutes}} minutes and counts as a full session
times.noRamadan: Ramadan times for this level come when they are announced

rules.book: The texts book prints each session's real time, from these bell times
rules.week: Neither the timetable nor the number of sessions before the exams changes

times.invalid: Write the time like 08:15, ending after it starts.

plan.heading: Plan and calendar
plan.intro: The plan pack proposes each session's lesson. The class stays on the pinned release until another is chosen.

meaning.official: Published by the issuing authority itself, through Minhajna.
meaning.in-force: Keyed by Minhajna's curators, and an official text confirms this edition applies this year.
meaning.latest-found: The newest edition found, keyed and checked. Check with your inspector.
meaning.stale: A later decision changed the subject's hours or content: nothing is proposed from it, and typing the items still works.
meaning.community: A teacher's or a district's plan, reviewed before publishing, and credited with its authors' consent. Not official.
meaning.example: A made-up pack to try the app, not a plan. Real plans come in Minhajna's packs.

anchor.hybrid: Timing: sessions per item, with weekly targets

plan.provenance: Based on: {{edition}}, {{issuer}}. Check with your inspector.
plan.noPackSub: You type the items, and the book works as with a pack: each session proposes the next item.
plan.noPacksYet: No pack for this subject and year yet. You type the items, and the book works as with a pack.
plan.calendarSub: Holidays, national days and exam weeks, shipped with the app, with no internet.
plan.packsIntro: Each pack for {{group}}, with its status, edition and source.
plan.pinNote: Each class stays on the pinned release until another is chosen.

ready.title: All set
ready.tagline: Anything can be changed later in Settings.
ready.pinnedSome: {{group}}: plan pinned for some classes, the others without a pack
ready.checkExams: September check, before the term {{term}} exams ({{date}})
ready.checkEnd: September check, before the end of term {{term}} ({{date}})
ready.checkIntro: The sessions the plan needs, and what your timetable and the calendar give after holidays, tests and exams:
ready.short: {{name}}: {{sessions}} short of what the plan needs
ready.even: {{name}}: just what the plan needs, nothing spare
ready.spareNote: Spare sessions are for remediation and the unexpected: they are not free time.
ready.tdNote: Guided work has its own list and count: it adds neither to the plan's sessions nor to its spare ones.
ready.noCheck: No class has a pack pinned, so there is nothing to check yet. The check is made once a pack is pinned.
ready.row: {{name}}: plan sessions, {{gives}} given and {{needs}} needed; guided work, {{tdGives}} given and {{tdItems}} items
ready.typed: No pack: you type what was done

today.none: No session in the timetable today.
today.tagContinued: Proposed by the plan · continues from last session
today.noProposal: No pack: you type what was done
today.packMissing: The pinned pack release is missing, so nothing is proposed.
today.notHeldMakeUp: Session not held · to be made up
today.snack: Session recorded for the texts book
today.undone: Recording undone: the session awaits confirmation.

outcome.title: How did the session go?
outcome.carry: What is left goes on next session (continued).
outcome.noStages: This item has no stages in the plan. Is it finished?
outcome.lastItem: It is the plan's last item.
outcome.reasonSub: A reason is optional and stays on your devices
outcome.reassurance: Any session can be corrected later, and every change is kept.
outcome.keptNotHeld: “Session not held” recorded. “{{item}}” stays first on the list and is proposed next session.
outcome.keptSkip: Recorded: “{{item}}” is skipped, and “{{next}}” is proposed next session.
outcome.keptSkipLast: Recorded: “{{item}}” is skipped; it is the plan's last item.
outcome.private: The reason stays on your devices: it never reaches a statement, a handover, the school's space or any total.
outcome.statement: In the progress statement, this session counts under “other”, without its reason.
outcome.snackPartial: Session recorded; what is left goes on next session
outcome.carryAt: What is left goes on in {{at}} (continued){{not}}.
outcome.keptNotHeldOn: “Session not held” recorded. “{{item}}” stays first on the list and is proposed on {{day}}.
outcome.makeUp: This session is to be made up
outcome.makeUpNote: The week’s summary shows “make-up owed” until it is scheduled. The app never decides on its own that a session is made up.

entry.title: Session details
entry.unavailable: This session cannot be opened here.
entry.book: How the texts book will take it
entry.addUnplanned: Add content from outside the plan
entry.unplannedPlaceholder: Written as is in the book; the plan does not move
entry.test: A test was given in this session
entry.factual: An extra line for the book
entry.factualPlaceholder: Shows in the texts book and in shared statements
entry.note: Private note · never leaves your devices
entry.noteWarning: Please do not write pupils’ health or discipline details, here or in the book.

lesson.title: Another lesson for this session
lesson.main: The main plan, around the class’s position
lesson.kept: What you choose is written in the texts book instead of the proposal. “{{item}}” stays first on its list and is proposed on {{day}}.
lesson.keptNext: What you choose is written in the texts book instead of the proposal. “{{item}}” stays first on its list and is proposed next session.

fix.title: Correction: the first version stays in the record
fix.promise: Any session can be corrected at any time. The correction is added with today’s date, and nothing is deleted.
fix.recorded: As recorded for the texts book
fix.reasonNote: The kind of reason shows with the correction, in the book’s corrections and the activity log. The words of “another reason” stay on your devices only; write nothing about a pupil there.
fix.added: Added on {{day}}, with no time of day.
fix.paper: If the session was copied into the paper book, correct it there too and sign it.

backlog.label: Earlier sessions awaiting confirmation
backlog.hint: Tap a session to leave it out, so its other outcome can be recorded.
backlog.later: The next week shows after this one.
